GRADUATION CEREMONIES == INTERNATIONAL YMCA LANGUAGE COURSES 


Graduation ceremonies for successful students of the International YMCA's 
fourth and final session of English and French language courses in 196) will take 
place -~ 


Thursday, November 26th, 8:15 p.m., YMCA Gymnasium, 5500 Park Ave., 


Guest speaker is Mrs. Trudy Faure. 


Monday, November 30th, 8:15 pem., YMCA Gymnasium, 5500 Park Ave., 

Guest speaker is Mr. Malcolm Davies, Bell Telephone Co, Ltd., 

Of the more than 300 persons who began the present session of classes 
on September 21st about 200 will receive certificates for passing the examinations 
at the respective levels. The "Y" offers 17 different classes: 11 basic English 
classes at 5 levels; one English business correspondence course and 5 French 


classes at 2 levels. 


In addition to the regular language classes the International YMCA this 
year is presenting specifically designed courses in Industrial Language in both 
French and English. These courses are taught at the plant and are related directly 


to the particular industries involved, 


This year more than 1,200 persons of many racial origins have attended 


the language programs of the International YMCA. 


Please contact Mr. Ward Minielly, Adult Program Secretary at 271-639 


for further information,
